name: Gaibiel (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of red, white and red, the white charged with a green tree above a black greyhound.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 3 February 2004 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Comunitat Valenciana no. 4695 of 19 February 2004; it is a flag of 2:3, tierced, with the tree, a traditional element of the arms of the town, and the greyhound taken from the arms of the Carrillo, former barons of Gaibiel.

features.role: greyhound beneath the tree, from the arms of the Carrillo
